issues.failed_invariant: Canonical, vendor, and active-cache Fashion Theme Team distributions must be byte-identical.
issues.evidence: The canonical parity checker reported 11 MISSING files under skills/fashion-theme-team/brain/visuals/ in plugins/fashion-theme-team.
issues.required_resolution: Restore the 11 canonical visual assets to the vendored distribution through the governed canonical sync path, rerun both parity checks, and attach a fresh independent verification receipt.
issues.diagnosis: The canonical files exist, but the worktree vendor contains none of them in HEAD. Root .gitignore line 435 matches skyyrose-*.png, and git check-ignore identifies that rule for these vendor paths. The vendored package verifier independently fails on the first missing brain visual.
issues.resolution_evidence: Governed canonical --apply --prune restored all 11 files; post-apply canonical-to-vendor parity is missing=0 changed=0 stale=0 and both package verifiers pass.

issues.failed_invariant: Canonical Fashion Theme Team package verification must complete with its declared verifier dependency set.
issues.evidence: scripts/verify.sh printed PASS for 14 E2E-routed capabilities, then exited 1 with missing verifier dependencies.
issues.required_resolution: Provision an isolated verifier environment from requirements-verify.txt and rerun canonical scripts/verify.sh; do not treat the partial route PASS as package integrity.
issues.resolution_evidence: uv run --isolated --no-project --with-requirements requirements-verify.txt bash scripts/verify.sh completed with PASS: fashion-theme-team motherbase integrity.

issues.failed_invariant: A FASHN credential must load from the governed macOS Keychain service so authenticated model and minimum eight-credit balance readiness can be established without disclosing the secret.
issues.evidence: The presence-only Keychain lookup returned FASHN API key not found for service skyyrose-fashn-api; the probe stopped before GET /credits.
issues.required_resolution: The founder must add the FASHN API key to the governed macOS Keychain service for the current account, then rerun this secret-safe zero-generation readiness stage to capture authenticated model and balance evidence.
issues.resolution_evidence: Secret-suppressed Keychain presence check passes and authenticated GET /v1/credits reports 99 credits against a minimum of 8.

issues.failed_invariant: The zero-credit environment preflight and paid Comfy client must derive the identical immutable contract fingerprint before any execution can be considered safe.
issues.evidence: The fresh focused suite produced unequal contract_sha256 values for the same contract in tests/integrations/test_comfy_client.py::test_environment_preflight_and_paid_client_share_exact_fingerprint.
issues.required_resolution: Unify the two contract canonicalization rules without weakening the contract, add regression evidence for the isolated and combined-suite paths, and rerun the complete Stage 1 zero-generation suite.
issues.diagnosis: The failure reproduces in isolation. Comfy/scripts/environment_plate_ooda.py::_contract_sha256 normalizes both credit_control.approval_receipt and post_merge_execution_gate, while skyyrose/integrations/comfy_client.py::runway_contract_sha256 normalizes only credit_control.approval_receipt.
issues.resolution_evidence: Both contract hash paths now normalize approval and merge-gate workflow state; isolated fingerprint regression and the exact complete Stage 1 zero-generation command pass.
